categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: high-tech equipment materials sales and services, automation supply systems, integrated systems, and customized equipment R&D and manufacturing. These segments serve semiconductor, optoelectronics, biotechnology, and traditional industries such as petrochemical and telecommunications. The business includes sales, agency, after-sales service, technical support, system integration, turnkey projects, and OEM/ODM manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-tech process equipment, automated control, precision machinery, laser and optical technologies, and software integration. The company develops and manufactures automated supply systems for gases, chemicals, and utilities, as well as factory monitoring and control systems. It also specializes in customized equipment design and manufacturing, integrating advanced semiconductor and display technologies such as EUV lithography sub-modules, Micro LED panel lamination, and chemical supply systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are in the semiconductor, flat panel display, LED, GaAs, biotechnology, and solar energy industries. The company serves major semiconductor foundries, IC packaging and testing firms, display panel manufacturers, and related high-tech factories. It also caters to traditional industries like petrochemical plants, general manufacturing, smart buildings, and medical device sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Taiwan and China, with significant presence in the United States, Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Myanmar, Indonesia), South Korea, Japan, and the Netherlands. It has multiple factories and offices across Taiwan and overseas subsidiaries and service centers in key semiconductor and display industry hubs globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream supplier and integrator within the semiconductor and display industry supply chain. It acts as an agent and distributor of high-tech equipment and materials, provides system integration and turnkey engineering services, and manufactures customized equipment. It supports upstream semiconductor fabs and downstream packaging and testing operations, bridging equipment suppliers and end manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product lines in high-tech equipment and materials, enhancing mechatronics engineering and turnkey plant design capabilities, and strengthening international cooperation. The company invests in R&D for automated supply systems, customized manufacturing equipment, and advanced process technologies. It actively develops IoT, big data, AI, 5G private networks, and AR/VR applications, while implementing ISO standards and ESG initiatives to promote sustainability and operational excellence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales, agency commissions, turnkey project contracts, engineering design and installation services, after-sales maintenance, and technical support. The company also earns income from OEM/ODM manufacturing and system integration services. Additionally, it receives rental income from overseas real estate investments and dividends from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a significant market share in semiconductor and display equipment and materials distribution in Taiwan and Greater China. It competes with major global suppliers and local integrators in automation and turnkey services. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive service offerings, technical expertise, extensive regional presence, and strong relationships with leading semiconductor and display manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$50.37 billion in 2022, a 46.17% increase from the previous year, with net income of NT$2.15 billion, up 42.52%. Earnings per share rose to NT$11.34. The company has shown steady growth in assets and equity, with a robust financial structure and increasing profitability over recent years. It maintains a diversified shareholder base and has expanded capital through convertible bonds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated, customized, and high-quality solutions tailored to semiconductor and display industry needs. It offers one-stop professional services combining equipment sales, system integration, and after-sales support, enhancing customer convenience and operational efficiency. Its strong R&D capabilities and local manufacturing enable cost-effective, innovative products. Commitment to sustainability, ISO certifications, and global service networks further differentiate it as a reliable partner in high-tech manufacturing ecosystems.
